nodes.name: Hourly 09:00-15:00 MT
nodes.notes: Fires 7x/day, 09:00-15:00 America/Denver — the window sends actually go out in. The lookback in 'Send window' is 25h, NOT the cron interval: the gap from the last fire to the next morning is ~18h. Re-reading is free (ingestion is idempotent per (recommendation_id, source)). Upgrade path: Iterable webhooks -> n8n Webhook trigger for near-real-time sends; the horizon sweep stays a cron either way, since '7-day return' is unanswerable until day 7.

nodes.name: Iterable export
nodes.notes: Header-auth credential must be name=Api-Key. NEVER inline the key here. Response is NDJSON (one event per line), so responseFormat=text. ponytail: no paging — a 25h window at ~50 sends/day is far inside one response. Upgrade path: follow Iterable's export paging if volume grows.

nodes.name: Post outcomes
nodes.notes: Waypoint STAGING. Swap the host here (and in the sibling POST node) when you move to production. Auth is the waypoint-authorization credential.

nodes.name: Nightly 03:00 UTC
nodes.notes: Set the n8n instance timezone to UTC, or change this expression — every window in this workflow is computed in UTC.

nodes.name: Amplitude user lookup
nodes.notes: ASSUMPTION: Amplitude user_id == pro_uuid. On no match the IF below drops the item — an unresolvable Pro produces NO row, never returned_*: false.

nodes.name: Amplitude user activity
nodes.notes: ponytail: 1000 most-recent events per Pro. Sound for this predicate because every horizon window ENDS ~now, so any truncation only drops events older than the window. Upgrade path: Amplitude Export API if windows ever stop ending at now.

nodes.name: Post returns
nodes.notes: Waypoint STAGING. Swap the host here (and in the sibling POST node) when you move to production. Auth is the waypoint-authorization credential.

nodes.name: Waypoint work list
nodes.notes: days=7, not 2: a touch whose QA took longer than the window would drop off the list and lose its sent_at/clicked/unsubscribed row entirely. Costs nothing — the response is bare (run_id, pro_id) pairs. Returns empty => the whole half is a no-op, which is fail-closed but SILENT; check it after any Railway deploy.

nodes.name: Waypoint work list (sweep)
nodes.notes: days=120, NOT 91. The 90d horizon is measured 90 days after the SEND, and the send trails the run by LCM drafting + human QA (up to ~3 days). At 91 the run had already aged out of the window, the Pro vanished from the work list, and the 90d return was discarded with no error. 120 leaves ~30 days of slack; raise it if QA turnaround ever grows.
